text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> P1: high error rate on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Triggered by 1797778888. Symptoms: increased 5xxs, client retries overwhelmed. Routing: hosted API. Pager link: https://pager.example/incident/1797778888 :rotating_light:

maya: oncall here, acknowledging. I'm starting an initial triage now. Can everyone drop service logs and recent deploy diffs here?

jon: saw a spike in 500s around the timestamp. Affected customers: several PLG accounts, one enterprise tenant (acme-corp) saw ~40% failed requests for 10m. I collected a short histogram of response codes, posting gist: https://gist.example/err-hist

sasha: looking at runtime host logs — kv-cache evictions increased, GC spikes on the serving runtime. Also noticed a kernel/userland lib change on the nodes rolled two hours before the incident. Suspect: network stack regression causing packet drops to model hosts.

maya: mitigation steps in progress: scaled inference pool +50% and enabled fallback-model routing for noisy routes to keep surface available. Commands run:```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deployment inference-serving --replicas=7
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate --fallback-model rwd-mini-v1
```
Result: errors decreased but latency still elevated.

samir: can we capture full request/response samples for a few impacted customers (no PII)? Need to attach to postmortem. @legal do we need any special handling?

legal: please redact any token or PII before sharing. For enterprise customers, route requests through our secure evidence bucket and note customer notice requirements. If exfil suspected, ping me immediately.

ops-bot: Evidence bundle uploaded: s3://evidence/1797778888/ (logs, metrics, sample traces). Also created timeline doc draft: https://docs.example/1797778888/timeline

jon: quick timeline note: 
```
03:41 - alert fires (error rate > 8%)
03:44 - oncall ack (maya)
03:47 - scaled pool +50%
03:52 - enabled fallback routing
04:05 - errors decreased but 99p latency up
04:20 - identified recent node kernel/lib bump
04:35 - rolled back node patch in canary
04:50 - full rollback to stable on affected pool
05:10 - system stabilized
```

sasha: evidence so far: host kernel update: `linux-kmod-5.19.2-2026-01-12`; serving runtime logs show repeated `net_retry` events, and model container restarts correlated with evictions. I'm attaching snips from the runtime logs to the evidence bucket.

maya: proposed post-incident plan (short):
- Owner: maya (triage + RCA coordination)
- Evidence collection: sasha, jon (complete by 1797780488)
- Timeline draft: jon (due 1797780488)
- Root cause analysis draft: sasha (due 1797781688)
- Action items and remediation plan: samir (due 1797782488)
- Peer review & sign-off: team reviewers = @jon, @sasha, @legal. Final sign-off target: 1797786088

samir: add remediation task: ensure kernel patch gating in canary for at least 48h with traffic patterns that emulate production model loads. Also add an automated alert for KV cache eviction surge threshold. I'll own both.

jon: I'll also add a test in our CI that runs an inference load profile against canary nodes for 30m after infra changes. Ticket to be created and linked.

legal: please prepare a short customer impact summary for enterprise outreach. If acme-corp was impacted, ops should own contacting them with timeline + remediation steps.

maya: agreed. @samir please own the acme-corp outreach draft (ops + legal review).

ops-bot: created tracking issue: https://tracker.example/ISSUE-4921 (RCA writeup, owners assigned, due dates set). Evidence items linked.

sasha: early contributing factors list for the RCA: 
- upstream kernel/lib update rolled to a subset of nodes without canary gating
- insufficient canary traffic profile to trigger the network regression in testing
- KV cache eviction and GC sensitivity in the serving runtime under partial packet loss
- no alert for rapid increased eviction rate

maya: action items (short):
1) Rollback & pin kernel version for affected pools (done) — owner: infra ops — status: done
2) Add canary gating policy for infra patches + 48h inference traffic test — owner: samir — ETA: 1797786088
3) Add eviction surge alert (Grafana/alerting) + runbook entry — owner: samir — ETA: 1797782488
4) CI canary inference stress test on infra changes — owner: jon — ETA: 1797782488
5) Update postmortem timeline and draft RCA writeup — owner: maya/sasha — ETA: 1797781688
6) Customer impact note for acme-corp + opt-in outreach — owner: samir/ops — ETA: 1797783288

jon: I've started the timeline doc and included links to traces. Please review and comment inline.

maya: requesting peer reviewers once draft is ready: @jon, @sasha, @legal. Please flag any missing evidence or legal concerns.

legal: will review customer language and advise on required disclosures. No immediate legal escalation.

sasha: attaching small log snippet showing `evict_count: 342 -> 1201` during the window and a short grep command used:```bash
grep -n "evict_count" /var/log/serving/*.log | sed -n '1,200p'```

maya: closing loop — please use the tracker issue for all follow-ups. I'll schedule an RCA review meeting tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Meeting invite will include the draft timeline, evidence links, and proposed remediation tasks.

samir: acked. I'll start the canary gating RFC and link in the tracker.

jon: ack, will review the draft and leave comments by EOD.

maya: thanks everyone. Requesting final sign-off in this thread once your review is complete. :white_check_mark:
